name: Broiled Paprika Pork Chop with Zucchini, Bell Pepper & Walnut Sauté

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Place pork chops on a broiler pan and season both sides with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place pan in the oven. Broil, flipping halfway through, until chops are no longer pink in the center and are browned at the edges, 12-14 minutes. Remove from oven and let rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim zucchini. Halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a large bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; medium dice. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Roughly chop walnuts. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add zucchini, bell pepper, walnuts, and spices to the pot with the garlic. Stir to combine, then cover and cook, undisturbed, until starting to soften, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Uncover pot and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until zucchini and bell pepper are fork-tender, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pork chops and veggie sauté between plates. Enjoy!
